title: Maximum Subarray Min-Product
goal: Maximize subarray sum times its minimum, reducing only the final maximum modulo the required prime.
strategy: A monotonic stack finds each minimum candidate widest eligible interval. Positive values make the widest interval best for that fixed minimum, and prefix sums supply its total.
